description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'PurgeStrategyTest' that tests the functionality of the 'PurgeStrategy' class in the 'orangehrmMaintenancePlugin' module. It sets up mock objects, loads test data fixtures, and includes multiple test methods to validate behavior such as retrieving services, match values, records, and class details related to purge strategies for Employee entities.

classes.name: PurgeStrategyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the 'PurgeStrategy' class, including setup for mock objects, fixture data loading, and multiple test cases to verify functionality related to entity purge operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates mock objects for PurgeStrategy, and loads test fixture data for Employee purge strategies.

methods.name: testGetPurgeEmployeeService
methods.description: Verifies that the 'getPurgeService' method returns an instance of 'PurgeService'.

methods.name: testGetMatchByValues
methods.description: Checks that 'getMatchByValues' returns the correct match criteria based on an employee number.

methods.name: testGetPurgeRecords
methods.description: Ensures that 'getEntityRecords' retrieves the correct Employee entity record corresponding to the provided match values.

methods.name: testGetParameters
methods.description: Validates that 'getParameters' returns the expected list of parameters used for purge strategies.

methods.name: testGetEntityFieldMap
methods.description: Checks that 'getEntityFieldMap' returns the correct mapping array for match and join fields.
